threads.body: [General] This changes published dependency metadata in a source-incompatible way: downstream code that currently compiles against the re-exported incubator artifact (or its `opentelemetry-semconv` / `opentelemetry-api-incubator` API dependencies) will stop compiling after an upgrade. `CONTRIBUTING.md:17-25` requires a breaking-change changelog entry and migration notes for this kind of compatibility break. Please document that affected consumers must declare these dependencies directly and apply the breaking-change label.

replies.body:
Addressed in c0fe7e9857aa73515a0ce99b79e09fc57cd42e97.

Analysis: Moving the incubator dependency from `api` to `implementation` removes it and its API dependencies from consumers' compile classpaths. I added the required Unreleased changelog entry, migration guidance to the PR description, and the `breaking change` label.

Upsides: Affected consumers receive discoverable upgrade guidance identifying every artifact they may need to declare directly.

Downsides: The changelog entry adds release-note detail for a dependency metadata change, but no runtime behavior changes.
